meta.title: A quick-flow auction uses fixed 2-day bidding and 4-day evaluation whatever the company policy
gaps: Quick-flow auction creation is not exposed as an operation.
Company policy values and their being ignored cannot be set or verified.
Auction strategy rank is not available as a read-back field.
Exact bid end of start + 2 days cannot be asserted.
Exact evaluation end of start + 4 days cannot be asserted.
Order type from the template is not available as a read-back field.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an auction round attached, not published.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals draft; Data check: “stages › rfx mode” equals auction.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals draft; Data check: “stages › rfx mode” equals auction.
